title: REQ · Generated boy PNGs and manifest entries exist at their declared sizes
summary: Run art:generate so boy PNGs and manifest entries are committed
description: Context: manifest still points to the placeholder character:boy SVG. Desired behavior: art:generate writes boy PNGs and adds entries with new ids character:boy-sheet (448x48) and character:boy-portrait (32x32) while the old SVG entries and scene content stay untouched. Expected result: manifest declares PNG boy assets.
acceptance_criteria: Given the manifest, when read, then character:boy-sheet is a spritesheet at 448x48 with 14 frames of 32x48 and a .png path
Given the manifest, when read, then character:boy-portrait is an image at 32x32 with a .png path
Given the manifest, when read, then the existing character:boy SVG entry is unchanged
technical_constraints: Output only from the deterministic script, no hand-edited PNGs
definition_of_done: PNG files and manifest entries produced by npm run art:generate
